title: Sheet
lede: Display content in a side panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.

examples.heading: With Side
examples.description: Use the `side` prop to control which edge the sheet slides in from.

examples.heading: Open
examples.description: The Default example open (a client-only state): the overlay, and the panel inset 12px from the right edge with the front-app overrides (rounded 16, 512 wide from the lg breakpoint, no padding of its own, a flex column), its header, body and footer padded 24. The reference's empty nested-portal div (display: contents, no box) is left out.
